title: Paper Execution
description: Create, step, and inspect durable simulated execution authority one market event at a time.

boundary.title: Presentation and command orchestration only
boundary.description: The server owns freshness, execution eligibility, prices, fill quantities, costs, risk, settlement, account effects, lifecycle state, replay progression, and reconciliation. Historical evidence shown here is not a claim of current executability.

demo.title: Demo v6 manual scenario
demo.description: Load the exact fresh historical Intent/Decision references and policy draft. Loading changes only this browser draft and performs no POST, Order creation, Step, freshness inference, or calculation.
demo.replaceConfirmation: Replace the current candidate and policy draft with the Demo v6 example.
demo.historicalWarning: The loaded allow Decision remains historical evidence; create-order revalidates current M31/M32 authority.

candidate.title: Select an allowed Intent and Decision
candidate.description: Only persisted allow Decisions with an exact matching persisted Intent are available for handoff.
candidate.loading: Loading bounded historical Intent and allow Decision evidence.
candidate.label: Allowed historical Decision and matching Intent
candidate.historicalWarning: Allowed means the historical M33 risk check passed. It does not establish current M31/M32 freshness or authorize execution; the create-order API decides the current handoff.

policy.title: Execution policy editor
policy.description: Enter every v1 policy value as an exact string. The backend remains validation and execution authority.
policy.draftWarning: All visible values are editable draft inputs, not backend facts or recommendations.
policy.maxFill: Maximum fill quantity per trade event
policy.maxFillNull: Leave blank only to submit an explicit null liquidity cap.

create.guidance: The command sends only selected M33 references, explicit policy strings or null, actor, and a hidden exact-retry key.

orders.title: Execution orders
orders.description: The bounded backend list restores historical orders after a browser reload and remains separate from the create draft.
orders.caption: Durable Paper Execution orders in backend order

detail.loading: Loading selected Order, Attempt, and Fill authority.
detail.title: Selected execution order
detail.historical: This immutable historical detail remains inspectable even when a later Step is refused as stale.
detail.authorityTitle: Order, state, and exact M31/M32/M33 handoff

step.guidance: One action submits at most one Step request. The browser neither selects an event nor computes or mutates execution, account, or replay authority.
step.terminal: This backend Order state is terminal; no Step action is available.

attempts.title: Execution Attempts
attempts.description: Ordered immutable Attempt, cursor, consumed-event, terminal, and execution-time risk evidence from the backend.
attempts.empty: No committed Attempts exist for this Order.

fills.title: Execution Fills
fills.description: Exact Fill, event, price, rounding, notional, commission, fee, tax, and charge strings are displayed without browser calculation.
fills.empty: No Fill exists for this Order. Absence is not presented as zero.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Run this server check explicitly. Historical Order, Attempt, and Fill inspection does not depend on a successful reconciliation.
